contractCoverage.obligation: Repeat saves reuse one canonical Candidate path for the same stable source identity.
Different stable source identities do not overwrite or collapse one another.
Every successful cross-workspace handoff exposes a recoverable route to Candidate review.
Candidate review opens the explicit source Object without conflating it with approval.

No AI or workspace handoff automatically approves a Candidate or promotes it to Knowledge.
